title: Nahi Hai Koi Rida Sar Pe Jo Daale Zainab
body:
Mai Hoo Naize Pe Tere Bhai Ke Baazoo Bhi Nahi
Hai Koun Ab Jo Sunega Tere Naale Zaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Apne He Khoo Se Racha Laya Hai Qaasim Mehdi
Oos Ki Dulhan Ko Zara Aur Saja Le Zaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Jo Soti Thi Mere Seene Pe Wo Roti Hai
Tu Sakina Ko Gale Apne Laga Le Zaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Bacchi Meri Panjo Pe Uth Ke Chalti Hai
Apne Baazu Ko Zara Aur Jhuka Le Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Aankh Tou Kiya Hai Musibat Pe Teri Aye Bibi
Phoot Kar Roye Teri Paao Ke Chaale Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Asre Ashur Chale Ran Ko Ye Kahe Kar Shabbir
Hum Tou Jaate Hain Tere Ghar Hai Hawaale Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Tou Bachpan Mei Bhi Kadiyal Jawaan Lagte The
Aise Maqtal Mei Ladey Tere Jiyale Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Nisaar Kar Diye Bacche Na Bach Saka Bhai
Kis Taraha Apne Biradar Ko Bacha Le Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Nauha Padh Kar Ke Sada Bibi Se Maango Ye Duaa
Hum Tou Hain Tere Humey Apna Bana Le Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Yu Tou Rauzey Ki Shabih Tere Bahot Dekhi Hai
Ho Raza Teri Tou Ab Shaam Bula Le Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Apne He Balon Se Chere Ko Chupa Le Zainab
